title: Approved ULA master claim report standard
section_order: INTEREST INSURED & RELEVANT CONDITIONS OF INSURANCE POLICY
CLAIM PRESENTED ON THE POLICY & ADJUSTMENT
Table 2 - Claim presented by the Assured & Adjustment
style_notes: Use the historical report only as a structural and professional-writing benchmark.
Use numbered, claim-specific factual paragraphs for the chronology and adjuster's note.
Present salient details and quantum in clear tables with ISO currency codes.
Preserve the approved two-column salient-details table, three-column damage schedule, and four-column claim-adjustment table; do not introduce substitute columns.
Separate source facts, policy wording, professional review points, and deterministic calculations.
When a value genuinely cannot be established after reviewing all evidence, state that it was not established from the reviewed evidence and identify the gap.
Do not reuse any historical claimant, policy, shipment, date, amount, finding, conclusion, or claim-specific wording.
